# Vendored BlinkMimic source subset

This directory is a source dependency of the Cyclo K1 task, not a standalone
upstream checkout. Use [the Cyclo guide](../../docs/blinkmimic.md) and the common
Cyclo launcher. Only `scripts/presets.sh` is consumed here. The upstream data
downloader, reproduction tools, figures and G1 assets are not vendored.

Original source: https://github.com/fuyichen0725/blinkmimic at
`d264658d6c9ce61fb52f9f0f8985a369f3ccc409`. LICENSE, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
and UPSTREAM.json retain attribution, source hashes and the contact-foot change.
For the original G1/LAFAN1 setup and paper reproduction, use that upstream
checkout and its own documentation.
